title: K8s payments-api pod crashlooping with OOMKilled
description: Payments-api pods on production cluster prod-us-east-1 started continuously restarting. kubectl describe pod reported Exit Code 137 (OOMKilled) during high volume checkout traffic. Memory limit was set to 512Mi, but JVM heap spiked past 600Mi due to unbounded cache allocation in order processing service.
resolution: Increased pod memory limits from 512Mi to 1.5Gi in deployment spec and configured JVM -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75. Applied memory alerts in Prometheus.

title: PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion on user-db
description: Web application began returning HTTP 500 errors to customers attempting to log in. Application logs showed 'FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections'. pgbouncer pool connections reached max_client_conn (1000) due to unindexed sequential scan query holding open transactions.
resolution: Terminated long-running query PID 44102 via pg_terminate_backend. Added composite index on (tenant_id, created_at) to avoid table lock. Configured pgbouncer transaction pooling mode and reduced idle transaction timeout.

title: Kafka order-events topic consumer lag surge and rebalance storm
description: Order fulfillment pipeline stalled. Grafana dashboard indicated consumer lag exceeding 450k messages on partition 3 and 7. Consumers in consumer-group 'fulfillment-worker' repeatedly dropped out causing constant group rebalances. Heartbeat timeouts were triggered because worker thread blocked on synchronous payment gateway HTTP call.
resolution: Temporarily scaled consumer group instances from 6 to 18 replicas. Wrapped third-party payment gateway call with a 2.5s circuit breaker and timeout, preventing consumer heartbeat thread starvation.

title: Envoy proxy returning 504 Gateway Timeout across microservice mesh
description: Ingress envoy proxies started throwing 504 Gateway Timeout on /api/v2/catalog endpoints. Envoy access logs showed response_flags='UT' (upstream request timeout). Downstream catalog service was unresponsive due to goroutine leakage after recent release.
resolution: Executed instant canary rollback of catalog service to v1.14.2. Increased Envoy upstream retry count to 2 with exponential backoff and patched catalog service leak.

title: Redis primary node high CPU and latency spike due to KEYS pattern command
description: Redis cluster cache-session node hit 100% CPU utilization. Application latency degraded by 800ms across all authenticated endpoints. Redis slowlog revealed execution of KEYS 'user:session:*' command run by an unoptimized cron job.
resolution: Killed running slow script on Redis primary using SCRIPT KILL. Refactored cron worker to use non-blocking SCAN with COUNT 500 instead of KEYS command. Added client command blacklist on KEYS.

title: AWS S3 PutObject failing with 403 AccessDenied after IAM role trust policy update
description: Data analytics batch export job failed overnight. Spark cluster logs showed AmazonS3Exception: Access Denied (Service: Amazon S3; Status Code: 403). CI/CD deployment had erroneously overwritten IAM instance profile trust relationship, removing sts:AssumeRole for spark worker role.
resolution: Restored correct IAM trust policy on role 'analytics-spark-worker-role' granting sts:AssumeRole to ec2.amazonaws.com. Re-ran batch ETL job successfully.

title: Elasticsearch cluster state RED due to unassigned replica shards after disk fill
description: Kibana dashboards and search queries failed with 'cluster_block_exception: blocked by: [TOO_MANY_REQUESTS/12/disk usage exceeded flood-stage watermark]'. Two data nodes had 96% disk utilization caused by untruncated debug log indices.
resolution: Deleted expired indices older than 30 days via Curator API. Adjusted cluster routing allocation disk watermark settings and expanded EBS volume size on data nodes from 500GB to 1TB.

title: Kubernetes DNS lookup timeout (CoreDNS packet drop under high UDP load)
description: Microservices in cluster prod-eu-west-1 reported intermittent 'i/o timeout lookup api.internal.svc.cluster.local'. CoreDNS pod logs showed high CPU and connection drop rates due to Linux conntrack table exhaustion on worker nodes.
resolution: Deployed NodeLocal DNSCache DaemonSet to cache DNS queries locally on each node and switch lookup protocol from UDP to TCP. Scaled CoreDNS replicas from 2 to 6.

title: PostgreSQL read replica replication lag critical alert
description: Alert triggered for database replica lag exceeding 120 seconds on reporting-db. Heavy analytical reporting queries saturated IOPS on the replica, stalling WAL receiver thread and delaying read-sync.
resolution: Cancelled long-running analytical query. Upgraded AWS RDS instance storage to Provisioned IOPS (io2 10000 IOPS). Configured max_standby_streaming_delay to 60s.

title: Docker hub rate limit hitting deployment pipelines
description: Deployment pipelines in Jenkins began failing during Docker build step with error 'toomanyrequests: You have reached your pull rate limit'. Automated autoscaling node provisioning also failed to pull base images.
resolution: Configured image pull secret with Docker Hub enterprise paid credentials across all Kubernetes namespaces and mirrored core base images to internal AWS ECR repository.

title: RabbitMQ queue memory alarm blocked all publishers
description: Message queue cluster paused publisher connections. RabbitMQ management UI showed memory alarm raised: vm_memory_high_watermark (0.4) reached. Unacknowledged message count surged to 2.1M because dead letter exchange consumer crashed.
resolution: Restarted dead letter queue consumer service. Flushed orphaned dead-letter queues. Raised RabbitMQ vm_memory_high_watermark to 0.6 and configured queue ttl of 7 days.

title: Kubernetes node NotReady due to disk pressure from dangling container layers
description: Worker node k8s-worker-prod-14 changed status to NotReady (DiskPressure). Kubelet failed to schedule new pods. /var/lib/docker/overlay2 filled with abandoned layers from dangling containers that failed garbage collection.
resolution: Ran crictl rmi --prune to clean up unused image layers. Updated Kubelet configuration imageMinimumGCAge to 5m and imageGCHighThresholdPercent to 80%. Cordoned and uncordoned node.
